INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LAREPSHDL_SELECT_SRC
(
                MIN_PYMT_REC_FLG
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_DAYS
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_MONTHS
                ,LR_FREQ_DAYS
                ,LR_FREQ_MONTHS
                ,NEXT_INT_DMD_REF_DATE
                ,NEXT_DMD_REF_DATE
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_CAL_BASE
                ,LR_FREQ_CAL_BASE
                ,BANK_ID
                ,INSTLMNT_PCNT
                ,INSTLMNT_IND
                ,SOL_ID
                ,CURRENT_INT_REC_FLG
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_HLDY_STAT
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_START_DD
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_WEEK_DAY
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_WEEK_NUM
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_TYPE
                ,NEXT_INT_DMD_DATE
                ,LAST_REC_FLG
                ,TS_CNT
                ,RCRE_TIME
                ,RCRE_USER_ID
                ,LCHG_TIME
                ,LCHG_USER_ID
                ,NEXT_DMD_DATE
                ,NUM_OF_DMDS
                ,FLOW_AMT
                ,NUM_OF_FLOWS
                ,LR_FREQ_HLDY_STAT
                ,LR_FREQ_START_DD
                ,LR_FREQ_WEEK_DAY
                ,LR_FREQ_WEEK_NUM
                ,LR_FREQ_TYPE
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
                ,FLOW_START_DATE
                ,FLOW_ID
                ,SHDL_NUM
                ,ACID
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                 CC.MIN_PYMT_REC_FLG
                ,CC.LR_INT_FREQ_DAYS
                ,CC.LR_INT_FREQ_MONTHS
                ,CC.LR_FREQ_DAYS
                ,CC.LR_FREQ_MONTHS
                ,CC.NEXT_INT_DMD_REF_DATE
                ,CC.NEXT_DMD_REF_DATE
                ,CC.LR_INT_FREQ_CAL_BASE
                ,CC.LR_FREQ_CAL_BASE
                ,CC.BANK_ID
                ,CC.INSTLMNT_PCNT
                ,CC.INSTLMNT_IND
                ,CC.SOL_ID
                ,CC.CURRENT_INT_REC_FLG
                ,CC.LR_INT_FREQ_HLDY_STAT
                ,CC.LR_INT_FREQ_START_DD
                ,CC.LR_INT_FREQ_WEEK_DAY
                ,CC.LR_INT_FREQ_WEEK_NUM
                ,CC.LR_INT_FREQ_TYPE
                ,CC.NEXT_INT_DMD_DATE
                ,CC.LAST_REC_FLG
                ,CC.TS_CNT
                ,CC.RCRE_TIME
                ,CC.RCRE_USER_ID
                ,CC.LCHG_TIME
                ,CC.LCHG_USER_ID
                ,CC.NEXT_DMD_DATE
                ,CC.NUM_OF_DMDS
                ,CC.FLOW_AMT
                ,CC.NUM_OF_FLOWS
                ,CC.LR_FREQ_HLDY_STAT
                ,CC.LR_FREQ_START_DD
                ,CC.LR_FREQ_WEEK_DAY
                ,CC.LR_FREQ_WEEK_NUM
                ,CC.LR_FREQ_TYPE
                ,CC.DEL_FLG
                ,CC.ENTITY_CRE_FLG
                ,CC.FLOW_START_DATE
                ,CC.FLOW_ID
                ,CC.SHDL_NUM
                ,CC.ACID
                ,CC.FILE_NAME
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.LNS_LAREPSHDL CC
            JOIN d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LAREPSHDL B
            ON CC.ACID  = B.ACID 
            AND CC.SHDL_NUM  = B.SHDL_NUM 
            AND CC.FLOW_ID  = B.FLOW_ID
            AND CC.FLOW_START_DATE  = B.FLOW_START_DATE
            AND LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME, 5) = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LAREPSHDL_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LAREPSHDL_GROUP_SRC
(
                MIN_PYMT_REC_FLG

                ,LR_INT_FREQ_DAYS

from 
(
	SELECT 				
                MIN_PYMT_REC_FLG
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_DAYS
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_MONTHS
                ,LR_FREQ_DAYS
                ,LR_FREQ_MONTHS
                ,NEXT_INT_DMD_REF_DATE

	GROUP BY 					
                MIN_PYMT_REC_FLG
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_DAYS
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_MONTHS
                ,LR_FREQ_DAYS
                ,LR_FREQ_MONTHS
                ,NEXT_INT_DMD_REF_DATE
                ,NEXT_DMD_REF_DATE
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_CAL_BASE
                ,LR_FREQ_CAL_BASE
                ,BANK_ID
                ,INSTLMNT_PCNT

                ,SOL_ID
                ,CURRENT_INT_REC_FLG
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_HLDY_STAT
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_START_DD
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_WEEK_DAY
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_WEEK_NUM
                ,LR_INT_FREQ_TYPE
                ,NEXT_INT_DMD_DATE
                ,LAST_REC_FLG
                ,TS_CNT
                ,RCRE_TIME
                ,RCRE_USER_ID
                ,LCHG_TIME
                ,LCHG_USER_ID
                ,NEXT_DMD_DATE
                ,NUM_OF_DMDS
                ,FLOW_AMT
                ,NUM_OF_FLOWS
                ,LR_FREQ_HLDY_STAT
                ,LR_FREQ_START_DD
                ,LR_FREQ_WEEK_DAY
                ,LR_FREQ_WEEK_NUM
                ,LR_FREQ_TYPE
                ,DEL_FLG
                ,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
                ,FLOW_START_DATE
                ,FLOW_ID
                ,SHDL_NUM
                ,ACID
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_LNS_LAREPSHDL]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.LNS_LAREPSHDL A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LAREPSHDL_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.ACID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SHDL_NUM, '-1') = COALESCE(B.SHDL_NUM ,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.FLOW_ID, '-1') = COALESCE(B.FLOW_ID ,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.FLOW_START_DATE, '-1') = COALESCE(B.FLOW_START_DATE ,'-1')
AND COALESCE(LEFT(A.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1') = COALESCE(LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
